title: Pass 3 reduced pressurized periclinal membrane-shell and depth-resolved anticlinal wall buckling parameters for Arabidopsis thaliana pavement cells
honesty_note: This table parameterises a REDUCED model (Foppl uniform-tension membrane on the 2D cell footprint + prestressed vertical anticlinal strip), not a 3D finite-element shell. Entries flagged assumption=true are order-of-magnitude modelling choices with the stated literature range; they are NOT values digitised from a figure or table of the cited papers. Entries flagged analytic=true are closed-form consequences of the governing equations used as solver verification targets.

periclinal_membrane_shell.cell_wall_youngs_modulus_note: Primary cell wall in-plane tensile modulus; order-of-magnitude range spanned by tensile tests of Arabidopsis / onion primary walls and the elastic moduli used in Sapala et al. (2018) MorphoMechanX pressurised-shell simulations. Chosen value is a mid-range assumption, swept via --shell-E.
periclinal_membrane_shell.pavement_cell_depth_note: Anticlinal wall height (outer to inner periclinal junction) of Arabidopsis cotyledon pavement cells; typical confocal z-extent 10-25 um (Armour et al. 2015 Plant Cell 27:2484; Sapala et al. 2018 3D templates). Mid-range assumption, swept via --wall-depth-H.
periclinal_membrane_shell.membrane_pretension_T0_rule: T0 = P * H / 2 (in-plane tension transmitted to the outer periclinal wall by the pressurised anticlinal walls of a slab cell of depth H; reduced estimate)
periclinal_membrane_shell.clamped_edge_bending_rule: ell_b = sqrt(D / T), D = E h^3 / (12 (1 - nu^2)); sigma_b,edge = 6 T theta_edge ell_b / h^2 (clamped membrane boundary layer, reported separately from the membrane stress)

laplace_stress_proxy_reference.source: Sapala et al. (2018) eLife 7:e32794 Box 1 & Fig. 3 (thin-walled pressure-vessel proxy; FEM maximum periclinal stress increases with LEC radius)

foppl_large_stretch_scaling.formula: T^3 ~ E h P^2 R^2 / 16  (bulge-test regime, T0 -> 0)  =>  sigma = T/h ~ R^(2/3)

disk_closed_form.formula: z(r) = P (R^2 - r^2) / (4 T);  z_max = P R^2 / (4 T);  theta_edge = P R / (2 T);  mean_strain = P^2 R^2 / (16 T^2)

inscribed_disk_comparison_bound.statement: For any footprint Omega containing the LEC disk B(R_LEC), the Dirichlet Poisson solution satisfies z_max(Omega) >= P R_LEC^2 / (4 T) (maximum principle / sub-solution comparison)

anticlinal_wall_depth_buckling.inner_face_anchoring_note: beta = k_in H / T_a is the dimensionless Robin stiffness of the inner periclinal junction (mesophyll-adjacent face): 0 = free (lobes uniform through depth), clamped = inner face held flat (lobes confined to the outer face). No depth-resolved empirical constraint on beta is vendored; the default is a modelling choice and the full sweep is rendered.

modal_depth_transfer_function.formula: g_k(zeta) = [k cosh(k zeta) + beta' sinh(k zeta)] / [k cosh(k H) + beta' sinh(k H)],  beta' = beta / H;  g_0(zeta) = (1 + beta' zeta) / (1 + beta' H)
modal_depth_transfer_function.clamped_limit: g_k(zeta) = sinh(k zeta) / sinh(k H);  g_0(zeta) = zeta / H

secondary_sources.citation: Armour WJ, Barton DA, Law AMK, Overall RL (2015) Plant Cell 27(9):2484-2500
secondary_sources.role: Differential growth of periclinal vs anticlinal walls during lobe formation in Arabidopsis cotyledon pavement cells; 3D confocal context for anticlinal wall depth

secondary_sources.citation: Timoshenko S, Woinowsky-Krieger S (1959) Theory of Plates and Shells, 2nd ed., McGraw-Hill
secondary_sources.role: Uniformly loaded circular membrane / clamped plate closed forms and the membrane-bending boundary layer used as solver verification targets
